sloka: परस्वानां च हरणं परदाराभिमर्शनम्।सुहृदामतिशङ्का च त्रयो दोषाः क्षयाबहाः ।। ६.८७.२४ ।।
transliteration: parasvānāṁ ca haraṇaṁ paradārābhimarśanam।suhṛdāmatiśaṅkā ca trayo doṣāḥ kṣayābahāḥ ।। 6.87.24 ।।

translations.english: "Dreadful killing of sages, haughtiness towards deities, irascibility, anger, animosity, refractorinessall these faults will put an end to one's life. These faults have obscured my brother's future just as rainy clouds veil the mountain."
translations.hindi: बे धीरे धारे निभय हो सेना सहित लोट पड़े । हनुमान जीं को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पास जाते देखे
